in_sanskrit.name: Basith
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lord of the Earth
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Basith एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The one who is the ruler and controller of the earth, representing stability, grounding, and nurturing energy.

in_hindi.name: Basith
in_hindi.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lord of the Earth
in_hindi.long_meaning: Basith एक हिंदू नाम है जो भारतीय संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The one who is the ruler and controller of the earth, representing stability, grounding, and nurturing energy.

in_tamil.name: Basith
in_tamil.meaning: இந்து பெயர் என்று பொருள் Lord of the Earth
in_tamil.long_meaning: Basith ஒரு இந்து பெயர் ஆகும், இது இந்திய கலாச்சாரத்தில் ஆழமான ஆன்மீக முக்கியத்துவத்தைக் கொண்டுள்ளது। The one who is the ruler and controller of the earth, representing stability, grounding, and nurturing energy.

in_telugu.name: Basith
in_telugu.meaning: హిందూ పేరు అంటే Lord of the Earth
in_telugu.long_meaning: Basith ఒక హిందూ పేరు, ఇది భారతీయ సంస్కృతిలో లోతైన ఆధ్యాత్మిక ప్రాముఖ్యతను కలిగి ఉంది। The one who is the ruler and controller of the earth, representing stability, grounding, and nurturing energy.

in_marathi.name: Basith
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the Earth
in_marathi.long_meaning: Basith हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The one who is the ruler and controller of the earth, representing stability, grounding, and nurturing energy.

in_bengali.name: Basith
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Lord of the Earth
in_bengali.long_meaning: Basith একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। The one who is the ruler and controller of the earth, representing stability, grounding, and nurturing energy.
